commands.purpose: Memory probe over frozen p05 and H4A-0/H4C metadata; no target/holdout registry opened
argv:
import json,sys,collections
p05=json.load(open("config/calibration/p05.json",encoding="utf-8"))
h4a0=json.load(open("docs/phases/HIST_VNEXT/H4A-0/APPROVED_INPUT_SET.json",encoding="utf-8"))
h4c=json.load(open("docs/phases/HIST_VNEXT/H4C/MEASUREMENT_MANIFEST.json",encoding="utf-8"))
idc=collections.Counter(p05["identification"].values())
linkage=p05["linkage"]
mi=h4a0.get("measurement_inputs")
hs=h4c.get("historical_status")
out={"p05_path":"config/calibration/p05.json","p05_identification_counts":dict(idc),"p05_identification":p05["identification"],"p05_linkage":linkage,"p05_linkage_len":len(linkage),"h4a0_measurement_inputs":mi,"h4c_historical_status":hs,"gate":"LINKAGE_AND_MEASUREMENT_EMPTY" if (not linkage and not mi) else "NONEMPTY"}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False))
sys.exit(1 if (not linkage and not mi) else 0)
commands.note: Expected exit 1 when p05 linkage and H4A-0 measurement_inputs are both empty; stdout is real read output.

Tokens and cost here equal the message_end sums and match model_usage.json; the wall/exit/byte figures match resource_usage.json. `message_roles` counts both message_start and message_end events per role, so the assistant entry is twice the assistant-turn count.
